A full-body photograph in a serene Japanese garden with raked pale gravel, a stone path, a low wooden bridge with a waist-high rail and a standard-height wooden gate, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as the figure, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, the camera set back far enough that the whole figure is visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on the figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

The paint covers the whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of the hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of the feet. The face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
